title: Entry Criteria for Dental Surgery Assistants Switching to Nursing Career
what_it_is: Entry Criteria for Dental Surgery Assistants Switching to Nursing Career

sections.label: DSA to nursing pathways
sections.summary: DSAs switching to nursing get no module exemptions; they can take ITE Nitec then polytechnic diploma courses, with alternative entry yardsticks beyond academics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: However, from an educational point of view, we have to recognise that the job scope and skillsets required of DSAs and nurses are quite different.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: And that is why we currently do not provide module exemptions or advance standing for DSAs switching into nursing careers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: One is to go through the National Institute of Technical Education (ITE) Certificate (Nitec) programme in nursing, which will then prepare them to be Enrolled Nurses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: After some years of experience, they can go through a diploma course in one of our polytechnics, which will then prepare them to become Registered Nurses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: All these courses and pathways have academic entry criteria, but they should not be the only yardstick for entry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: There must be also alternative yardsticks, such as good job performance or achievements in other courses, for DSAs to be enrolled.

sections.label: SkillsFuture lifelong learning accessibility
sections.summary: Under SkillsFuture, more lifelong learning opportunities and upgrading pathways are provided, with post-secondary institutions recognising skills and experience beyond academic qualifications for adult learning enrolment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Under SkillsFuture, we do not just provide more opportunities for lifelong learning, but also enhanced accessibility to upgrading pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We will continue to work with our post-secondary education institutions to find meaningful ways to recognise an individual's skills and experience beyond academic qualifications for enrolment into their adult learning programmes.

sections.label: Modular training direction
sections.summary: Modular training is a direction being pushed very proactively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The other is what the Member just mentioned, which is modular Page: 22 training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It is a direction that we are pushing very proactively towards.
